description: Na₂SrV₃O₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with five VO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one VO₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one VO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 90°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.72 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four VO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with four NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 90°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.67 Å. Sr is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.60-3.06 Å. There are three inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted VO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four VO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-64°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-2.00 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-65°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-1.80 Å. In the third V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-66°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-1.79 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sr, and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Sr and two V atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, and two V atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one V atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one V atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, and two V atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one V atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₃V trigonal pyramids. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Sr and two V atoms.
